import java.util.*;

public class Main {
    static int n, m;
    static long[] a;
    static List<Long> a1List = new ArrayList<>();
    static List<Long> a2List = new ArrayList<>();

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        if (!sc.hasNextInt()) return;
        n = sc.nextInt();
        m = sc.nextInt();
        a = new long[n];
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            a[i] = sc.nextLong();
        }

        int n1 = n / 2;
        generateSums1(0, 0, n1);
        generateSums2(n1, 0);

        // Remove duplicates and sort a1
        Set<Long> setA1 = new HashSet<>(a1List);
        Long[] sortedA1 = setA1.toArray(new Long[0]);
        Arrays.sort(sortedA1);

        long ans = 0;
        for (long i : a2List) {
            // Target value for bisect_left is m - i
            long target = m - i;
            int idx = lowerBound(sortedA1, target);
            
            // Python code uses a1[j-1] + i. 
            // Since a1[j] is the first element >= m-i, a1[j-1] is the largest element < m-i.
            if (idx > 0) {
                long val = sortedA1[idx - 1] + i;
                if (val > ans) {
                    ans = val;
                }
            } else {
                // If idx is 0, and since Python uses negative indexing (a1[-1]),
                // we need to handle the case where j=0 implies the last element of the array.
                // However, based on the logic: a1 is sorted, i is from a2.
                // In Python: a1[j-1] where j=0 results in a1[-1] (the largest element).
                long val = sortedA1[sortedA1.length - 1] + i;
                if (val > ans) {
                    ans = val;
                }
            }
        }
        System.out.println(ans);
    }

    static void generateSums1(int i, long sum, int limit) {
        if (i == limit) {
            a1List.add(sum);
        } else {
            generateSums1(i + 1, (sum + a[i]) % m, limit);
            generateSums1(i + 1, sum, limit);
        }
    }

    static void generateSums2(int i, long sum) {
        if (i == n) {
            a2List.add(sum);
        } else {
            generateSums2(i + 1, (sum + a[i]) % m);
            generateSums2(i + 1, sum);
        }
    }

    static int lowerBound(Long[] arr, long target) {
        int low = 0, high = arr.length;
        while (low < high) {
            int mid = (low + high) / 2;
            if (arr[mid] >= target) high = mid;
            else low = mid + 1;
        }
        return low;
    }
}
